issues.on_page: Cemetery: Operating supplies 11,400; Utilities and telephone 710
issues.issue: Cemetery spending would normally be health/welfare. The extractor followed the fund statement (p5), whose General Fund 'Public works' 12,110 equals the Cemetery department total. Defensible, but it is a judgment call (detail[91] same).

'Transportation' is a context label in category_decisions. Mapping it to fuel is a guess: it could be vehicle costs, travel or mileage. Same for detail[51] (Ambulance 5,436), detail[59] (Park 2,922), detail[67] (Pool 155) and detail[72] (Sports Complex 1,424).

issues.on_page: Transfers from (to) other funds: Administrative (408,459); Police 162,390; Fire 39,985; Park 70,822; Sports Complex 45,223; Auditorium 36,030; Total (54,009)
issues.issue: Recorded as printed per department, and the lines net to the fund-level (54,009). But 354,450 of the gross amounts moves between General Fund departments, not between funds, so gross detail transfers out (408,459) far exceed the fund statement's transfers out (54,009 General + 39,985 Debt Service). Labels 'Transfers In/Out' on intra-fund department moves may mislead.
